insight.headline: A 3.24 ERA should be winning more games.
insight.detail: Staff ERA is 3.24. That's held up. But New York is just 5-5 in the last ten. A .720 OPS hasn't turned good pitching into wins.
insight.why: staff carrying (3.24 ERA) · OPS at .720 · 5–5 in the last ten

narrative.top_frame: Zero runs. Zero hits with runners in scoring position. Zero answer when Baltimore's pitcher found his rhythm in the fourth inning.
narrative.what_this_means: The Yankees had a game to win and chose not to show up for it. This is not inconsistency anymore. It's a choice made in real time, inning after inning, the same choice they've made for two weeks. They came to Yankee Stadium in daylight against a team they should beat and produced nothing, which is the most honest way to say they lost to themselves before they lost to Baltimore.
narrative.what_to_watch: Cam Schlittler takes the mound tomorrow against Boston with a 1.23 ERA over his last four starts. Payton Tolle is throwing 3.03 for the season. A real starter on a real team. This is a chance to prove that yesterday was an aberration, not a preview.
